verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no public API for driving Bruno programmatically, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The Bruno CLI, the in-script `bru` JavaScript API, and plain-text collection files are a separate CLI capability, a scripting building block and a file-based workaround, so none of them counts as a documented public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
